title: Recovered 'relic' tech brought in by security team for telepathic study
place_text: Baker Victory Services, Western New York

tellings.quote: it'd be like eight security personnel and a huge box, you know, and then I would be in the room with a team of people watching me

plain: Between about 2008 and 2010, at a place called Baker Victory Services in Western New York, a man named Jordan Jose says that as a child he was put in a room with a huge box, brought in by about eight security guards, while a team watched him, as part of a study of telepathy with recovered "relic" technology. Jose tells this as his own experience, and names a man called Jacob Barber in connection with it. If true, it would mean children were being tested for mind-to-mind contact with recovered objects.
